_note: Kafka REST Proxy (v2) target for the Delhi T3 terminal simulation. Topic names follow the cluster's aiop-<airport>-topic-<domain>-event-<tier>-v<n> pattern and must exist before publishing (the v2 proxy cannot create topics). Credentials are NOT stored here: set KAFKA_REST_USER and KAFKA_REST_PASSWORD; KAFKA_REST_URL overrides the URL.
